scope.summary: Implement UV strain compensation (spec 13.22; REQ-036, PREQ-025): detect per-face texel stretch/compression under extreme channel states and auto-correct detail-map tiling/weights or apply per-channel UV adjustment so microdetail density stays visually constant at 300%-class extremes, deterministic and hash-cached.
acceptance_criteria: Strain detector computes per-face UV stretch/compression ratios for the current channel state vs base and emits strain maps (the Faceform stretch/compression-mask prior art, PREQ-025).

Compensation: above the documented strain threshold, detail-map tiling/weights re-correct (or a per-channel UV adjustment applies); at 300% breast volume the microdetail density deviation stays within the documented bound (REQ-036).
Compensation is deterministic and cached by channel-state hash (no recompute when channels are unchanged).
When compensation cannot hold the bound (beyond design range), a typed validation finding surfaces instead of silent smearing.
scope.risk_if_missed: At 300% breast volume texels stretch visibly and microdetail smears - an unsolved Daz failure; without strain compensation the extreme ranges the whole product targets look worst precisely at their selling point (REQ-036, PREQ-025).

gui_obligation.not_applicable_reason: Backend/solver scope: behavior is observable via TraceProjection, typed TAILOR_BODY_* receipts, and the 13.12 capture APIs; operator/model GUI exposure rides the BodyKit panes (13.27) and is validated there.

hbr_int_009_tier_obligations.reason: Emits/extends the TAILOR_BODY_* KernelEventType family on the EventLedger per Section 13.16 (extends the 13.14 canonical list).
internal_diagnostics ships with WP-KERNEL-012; wire the open diagnostic-event API for this behavior in the WP-KERNEL-016 retrofit.
Palmistry external watcher ships with WP-KERNEL-012/016; long generation/bake/export runs get child-stall watch coverage in the retrofit.

risks: Broad MT scope can hide multiple review targets.
Markdown MT lists may disagree with packet-declared active/next MT truth.
Receipt routing may target an old MT if contract identity is omitted.
minimum_controls: Exactly one primary proof target per MT unless the packet records why not.
MT identity must be stable and referenced by receipt correlation.
Generated projection drift must not wake Coder or Validator by itself.
